items: Line 4: 'You mean... killing everybody.' A statement, flat, not a question.
Line 15: Maddie on the radio to the boss as she rolls away: 'Hey, boss. I've given them the presentation. We can only hope they trust us.' We never hear the boss.
Go on 1D? Say go and I start the voices, then the stills, then the talking clips (all lip-sync redone), the new cut, the page and Premiere.
Unless you say otherwise: the lady is seen at the door for line 4.

replies.1-1A-L5: → 1D line 5: 'Yeah, we're really sorry about that. [pause] We do want to try and fix it.' New voicing.
replies.1-1A-L7: → 1D line 7: the 'Yeah' cut off the front of the take you like, so it's 'That's... that's fair', then a held pause. Agreed, 'Yeah' after 'are you joking?' reads as 'yes, we are'.
replies.1-1A-L12: → 1D line 12: Derek re-voiced with shock and emotion, close to a disbelieving laugh, and an exclamation mark. New talking clip for the lip-sync.
replies.1-1A-L13: → 1D line 13: 'Look. I understand why you wouldn't trust us. I'm going to leave you a video to watch. And I'll come back tomorrow.' So nothing physical is shown (question 1 answered).
replies.1-1A-L15: → 1D line 15: 'I've given them the presentation I showed you earlier. I hope when they watch it, they'll trust us.' Said to us, the audience.
replies.1-1D-L4: → 'You mean... killing everybody.' A statement, the penny dropping. She's seen at the door, with a new talking clip for the lip-sync.
replies.1-1D-L15: → Your last option: 'Hey, boss. [beat] I've given them the presentation. [beat] We can only hope they trust us.' One-way radio, the boss never heard. It also avoids saying 'tomorrow' twice.
